title: Moltoyo Text Density Study
download_scope: Measurements and metadata only. No source text, sample text, abstracts, images or PDFs are included. Source works retain their own rights; no licence is granted over source content.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
license.scope: Applies only to the original measurements, the dataset compilation and the original documentation produced by Moltoyo in this download set — the only rights Moltoyo holds.
license.attribution: Attribute Moltoyo, name the dataset version MTD-v1-2026, link to https://moltoyo.com/research/text-density-study and to the licence, and indicate if modifications were made.
license.exclusions: This licence does not apply to third-party source works, their original prose or any third-party rights. Original source texts are not distributed.

documented_source_mix_revisions: A second news source was added: 35 Global Voices samples alongside Wikinews.
SciDev.Net was excluded because its material could not be verified for the protocol.
NIST material was unavailable at the required cleaned-word threshold.
The European Commission quota was reduced from 13 to 1; the remainder was reassigned to Wikipedia and GOV.UK.
The GOV.UK technical quota was reduced from 22 to 9; the remainder was reassigned to 41 CC BY technical publications sourced via Europe PMC.

steps: Remove non-prose material such as references, navigation, figures, tables and abstracts.
Collapse all whitespace runs to a single space before sampling.

sampling.selection: Within each eligible quota pool, documents were ranked by SHA-256(seed|version|rank|source_document_id); maximum 2 fiction works per author.
start_formula: N = number of eligible cleaned tokens
start = U <= 0 ? floor : floor + Number(h % BigInt(U + 1))
sampling.locators: sample_start_locator and sample_end_locator are zero-based token indices; the end locator is inclusive.

definitions.word: Trim the sample, then split on /\s+/; an empty string has zero words.
definitions.characters_with_spaces: Unicode code points, counted with Array.from.
definitions.mape: Mean of absolute_percentage_error over the rows in scope.
definitions.note: These are the frozen 2026 study definitions. They are not the same as the counting rules used by Moltoyo's live tools since October 2026.

source_metadata_review.confirmed: 91 Europe PMC articles confirmed at article level: 89 CC BY 4.0 and 2 CC0.
errata: 8 of 15 Wikinews samples have recorded publication dates that differ from their source dates; these 8 include the 7 pre-cutover items.
Those 7 should be CC BY 2.5 under Wikinews:Copyright (https://en.wikinews.org/wiki/Wikinews:Copyright), not the recorded CC BY 4.0.
The same 7 violate the original rule of selecting items published after 16 December 2024; they are retained in the published v1 with this documented erratum. Measurements are unchanged.
source_metadata_review.pending: Other licence, attribution and source-date checks are ongoing. Global Voices partner content and Project Gutenberg jurisdiction questions require clearance before any prose could be distributed.
source_metadata_review.note: No promise is made that the rights status of every source has been validated.

files.measurements.json: Same 250 rows with numeric JSON types
files.sources.json: 250 source links (sample_id, source, url); no licence or authorship claims
files.metadata-errata.json: 8 per-sample source date/licence corrections from the 5 October 2026 review; metadata only, no prose
